basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old currently serving in the military and pursuing a degree in psychology through UMGC. I have a keen interest in psychology and technology, which is why I spend a lot of time on subreddits related to VR and gaming PCs. I recently moved to Texas with my partner and our dog, Max. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work or on weekends. I'm quite outgoing and always eager to learn, but I can be a bit skeptical about online advice.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in psychology, currently studying for a degree. My interest in technology is self-taught, primarily through online resources and community discussions. My military experience has given me a disciplined approach to time management, which I apply to my studies.
